The compact and split parts are defined without Choice, while nonemptiness of the family over which the extrema are taken uses the repaired Choice-scoped conjugacy theorem; only that existence clause is now qualified.
The Cayley normalizations use the Killing-dual vector and coroot interfaces, both now Choice-scoped; the already declared axiom dependency is now made an explicit hypothesis of the definition.

Both the regular-hyperplane description and the centralizer-dimension formula now assume Choice; the corollary's statement, Given block, and dependency list carry that common hypothesis before either interface is used.

The displayed matrices directly prove the root spaces, Killing-dual identity, and coroot normalization in sl_2. Unneeded Choice-scoped general decomposition and dual/coroot dependencies were removed while preserving the concrete result.

The relative-bound/resolvent equivalence is choice-free: AR_A(z)=zR_A(z)-I and Bx=BR_A(z)(z-A)x prove both directions directly. The unnecessary newly Choice-scoped graph-closure dependency was removed.

Stone-Weierstrass density remains choice-free, but the parameter-independence consequence uses the repaired self-adjoint resolvent interfaces. That consequence, its fact, and its dependency now carry Countable Choice locally.

The projection calculation already proves surjectivity and complemented kernel, but the repaired regular-value theorem also requires a maximal specified domain atlas. The example now equips both Banach spaces with their standard maximal smooth atlases.

The corollary now fixes the continuous representative required by the hitting theorem. Its restart step conditions the fixed Borel future-path hitting event and evaluates a kernel equal to one for every deterministic state, avoiding the invalid direct substitution of the random level c-B_n.

The repaired Pincus interface does not transfer Countable Choice alone. The item now records Tachtsis's exact relative-consistency theorem together with its published erratum and no longer claims the unavailable transfer argument.

The endpoint obstruction and Tietze argument remain valid, but Brunner alone does not source the Countable-Choice consistency consequence. The exact Tachtsis theorem and erratum now source that second model.

DMC still implies Urysohn and the repaired supplier still gives a Countable-Choice model where Urysohn fails. The proof wording and sources now refer to the corrected Tachtsis theorem rather than an unavailable transfer.

The metatheoretic monotonicity argument is unchanged, but its Countable-Choice countermodel is now supplied by Tachtsis's corrected theorem. The stale Brunner-only source annotation was replaced by the exact source and erratum.

The deficiency-space definitions, closed-range identities, basis-cardinality argument, and Cayley transform remain mathematically unchanged; four multiline display sources were joined so the existing formulas actually render.
The finite-rank projection characterizations of discrete and essential spectrum are logically unchanged; their two split display sources were joined to preserve the exact formulas in rendered output.
